sanskrit:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥ १३-१४॥
iast:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato’kṣiśiromukham
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati 13-14
translation: With hands and feet everywhere, with eyes, heads and mouths everywhere, with ears everywhere, He exists in the world, enveloping all.
